name: @care/functions
description: C.A.R.E. System 後端：Firebase Cloud Functions（違規登錄、雙軌反思卡工作流、累犯偵測、安全觀察員）

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,auth
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-care-rules "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
